attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Massachusetts military retirement income exclusion. Skeleton — see issue #446. 100% exclusion for military retirement pay + SBP, MSRRA / SCRA compliant. Per MA Gen. Laws ch. 62, § 2 (2025).

Massachusetts state income tax. Flat 5.00% rate (MA Gen. Laws ch. 62, § 4, 2025) on AGI minus the filing-status personal exemption. Personal exemption: $4,400 Single/MFS, $8,800 MFJ, $6,800 HOH. Plus a 4% surtax (Fair Share Amendment) on AGI above the surtax threshold ($1,083,150 in 2025). Writes result.ma_taxable_income, result.ma_state_tax, result.ma_surtax.

initial_action.action_comment: Reset MA tax fields and log calculation start
initial_action.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.ma_state_tax xdef 0.0 /result.ma_taxable_income xdef 0.0 /result.ma_surtax xdef " Massachusetts Tax Calculation (Form 1) — flat 5.00% + 4% surtax over $1,083,150" job.audit_trail swap addto

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Married Filing Jointly or Qualifying Surviving Spouse
condition_details.condition_dsl: job.filing_status is equal to "MFJ" or job.filing_status is equal to "QSS"

condition_details.condition_comment: Filing status is Head of Household

action_details.action_dsl: set result.ma_taxable_income = the maximum of (result.agi - 8800.0) and 0.0; set result.ma_state_tax = result.ma_taxable_income * 0.05
action_details.action_postfix: result.agi ma_exemption_joint f- 0.0 fmax /result.ma_taxable_income xdef result.ma_taxable_income ma_tax_rate f* /result.ma_state_tax xdef result.agi ma_surtax_threshold f- 0.0 fmax ma_surtax_rate f* /result.ma_surtax xdef result.ma_state_tax result.ma_surtax f+ /result.ma_state_tax xdef " MA taxable income (MFJ, $8,800 exemption): $" result.ma_taxable_income cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " MA state tax (5.00% + 4% surtax over $1,083,150): $" result.ma_state_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
